In the Nominative 1st-Case singular त्व is substituted for युष्म् and अह for अस्म्।

Terms: सर्वनाम युष्मद्- अस्मद्

In the remaining cases of the singular त्व is substituted for युष्म् and म for अस्म्।

Terms: सर्वनाम युष्मद्- अस्मद्

For the Accusative -2nd case singular of युष्मद् and अस्मद् are substituted त्वा and मा respectively (when a word precedes and these substitutes are अनुदात्त).

Terms: सर्वनाम
